pairs.ask: UpKeep Command Center: Tile grid, how the four agent tiles sit across Ethan's wide screen.

optionA.label: Four across
optionA.desc: All four agents side by side, everything above the fold.

optionB.label: Two by two
optionB.desc: Bigger tiles in two rows; the lower row needs a scroll.

pairs.ask: UpKeep Command Center: Ethan's strip, where priorities, alerts and Waiting on Max sit.

optionA.label: Strip across the top
optionA.desc: One band over the tiles: priorities, alerts, waiting on Max.

optionB.label: Side rail on the left
optionB.desc: A tall rail beside the tiles, read top to bottom.

pairs.ask: UpKeep Command Center: Density, how much each tile shows before you open anything.

optionA.label: Calm, lists folded
optionA.desc: Four rows a list, folds closed with a one-line summary.

optionB.label: Dense, lists open
optionB.desc: Smaller type, longer lists and the top fold already open.

pairs.ask: UpKeep Command Center: Tile widths, whether every agent gets the same width or the busiest leads.

optionA.label: Equal tiles
optionA.desc: Same width for every agent, fixed order.

optionB.label: Busiest tile leads wider
optionB.desc: The tile with the most waiting on Max goes first and wider.

pairs.ask: UpKeep Command Center: Row actions, how buttons like Approve show inside a tile.

optionA.label: Inside the row fold
optionA.desc: Tap a row to see its buttons; the list stays short.

optionB.label: Always showing
optionB.desc: Buttons sit open on every row, nothing to tap first.

pairs.ask: UpKeep Command Center: Phone order, what Ethan sees first on his phone.

optionA.label: Priorities first
optionA.desc: Today's priorities, then alerts, then waiting on Max.

optionB.label: Waiting on Max first
optionB.desc: Approvals lead, then priorities and alerts.

pairs.ask: UpKeep Command Center: Phone tiles, how each agent tile looks on a phone.

optionA.label: Full tiles
optionA.desc: Each tile shows its lists and folds; longer scroll.

optionB.label: Numbers only, tap to open
optionB.desc: Just the four numbers per agent; tap for the list.

pairs.ask: UpKeep Command Center: Header, how the title, mark and Apps Home line up.

optionA.label: One-row header
optionA.desc: Apps Home, mark, title and chip on one line.

optionB.label: Two-row header
optionB.desc: Apps Home on its own line, the title row below it.

pairs.ask: UpKeep Command Center: Tile numbers, how the four key numbers sit at the top of a tile.

optionA.label: Boxed numbers
optionA.desc: A soft framed row of four numbers with small notes.

optionB.label: Big open numbers
optionB.desc: Larger numbers on the tile itself, no frame.

pairs.ask: UpKeep Command Center: Side margins, how much cream sits at the edges of the big screen.

optionA.label: About five percent
optionA.desc: Roomy edges; tiles a little narrower.

optionB.label: Slim edges
optionB.desc: About two percent; tiles use nearly the full width.
